name: gateway-matrix
description: Matrix gateway. `send` posts a text message to a room via the Client-Server REST API. `start`/`stop` (sync/long-poll) not yet implemented.

commands.start: Connect to a Matrix homeserver and stream events (NOT IMPLEMENTED)
commands.stop: Stop a running gateway service (NOT IMPLEMENTED)
commands.send: Send a text message to a room (positional: room_id text)
